mapper.select: SELECT id, contract_id, initiation_id, revenue_code, recognition_method, period, amount, recognition_date, milestone, percent_complete, invoice_id, status, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, description, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_profit_revenue WHERE revenue_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pmis_profit_revenue SET status = #{status}, confirmed_by = COALESCE(#{confirmedBy}, confirmed_by), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, contract_id, initiation_id, revenue_code, recognition_method, period, amount, recognition_date, milestone, percent_complete, invoice_id, status, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, description, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_profit_revenue WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY recognition_date DESC

SELECT period, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM pmis_profit_revenue WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED' AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY period ORDER BY period
SELECT contract_id, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM pmis_profit_revenue WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED' AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY contract_id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM pmis_profit_revenue WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED' AND deleted = 0
